name: cx-siren
task: Go to the exit, and whenever the siren rings, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) captures the commanded goal of reaching the exit, and Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) captures 'whenever the siren rings, turn it off' — the siren is a lasting condition that stops when the switch is toggled, so each ringing period demands a toggle at or after it, and a later second start re-owes it. The machine's FINAL_STATES (u2) reflects exit with no pending toggle debt, matching the task.

texts: Whenever the siren is ringing, toggle the switch to turn it off.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!siren_ringing) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u3
(u0, at_exit&siren_ringing&switch_toggled) -> u2
(u1, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u0
(u1, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u3
(u1, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u2
(u3, switch_toggled) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u0, at_exit&!siren_ringing, u2) -> 11
(u0, at_exit&siren_ringing&switch_toggled, u2) -> 11
(u1, !at_exit&switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
(u1, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u3) -> 1
(u1, at_exit&switch_toggled, u2) -> 12
(u3, switch_toggled, u2) -> 11
